Trump Hails Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan Defence Pact; Iran Rejects US Talks Claim

US President Donald Trump described the Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan defence agreement as a "big, bold" step, suggesting it signifies Middle Eastern countries uniting for their security. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) rejected claims of backchannel talks with the US. Meanwhile, an agreement was reported between Iran and Oman for ships to transit the Strait of Hormuz. The defence pact, referred to as the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, is being analyzed as an experiment in regional self-reliance.
